findings.description: After pouring the first batch, the empty glass cup disappears above the frame and the person reaches an empty left hand into the metal bowl at 00:04. Between 00:04 and 00:05, a small clear glass bottle with a white cap spontaneously materializes on the countertop to the right of the metal bowl without anyone placing it there.
